title: Kanji Paham
shortDescription: KanjiPaham is a Japanese Kanji learning platform for Indonesian learners, featuring JLPT lessons, interactive quizzes, and progress tracking.
description:
KanjiPaham is a Japanese Kanji learning platform built for Indonesian learners. The application provides structured Kanji lessons based on JLPT levels, covering meanings, readings, stroke orders, and vocabulary examples.

To make learning more engaging, KanjiPaham includes interactive quiz modes such as multiple choice and flashcard-based exercises, allowing users to actively practice and reinforce their knowledge. The platform also incorporates learning progress, daily goals, and gamification elements to encourage consistent study habits.

The interface was designed around a warm Japanese-inspired visual identity while maintaining a clean, accessible, and responsive experience across desktop and mobile devices.

title: MoneyFlow - Personal Finance App
shortDescription: Cross-platform mobile application designed to help users track income and expenses efficiently.
description: Cross-platform mobile application designed to help users track income and expenses efficiently. Focused on translating high-fidelity Figma designs into responsive Flutter code with a modular widget structure to support database and state management logic.

title: Sparepart Monitoring System
shortDescription: Web-based inventory system for real-time spare part stock management and preventive maintenance.
description: Web-based inventory system for spare part stock management at PT Kalbe Farma Tbk to help the Production Line 1 Department track and manage inventory efficiently. Implemented real-time monitoring, automated stock alerts, and role-based access control, reducing manual tracking errors and supporting preventive maintenance.

title: Chill Study (LMS)
shortDescription: Full-featured LMS platform with Google OAuth, Midtrans payments, and course progress tracking.
description: Full-featured LMS platform with Google OAuth authentication, Midtrans payment gateway integration, and role-based access control for admins and users. Enables users to enroll in paid/free courses, track learning progress, and access responsive modules across devices.
